spec.name: Orange Kitchen Sweet Roll
spec.description: A plump, stepped golden sweet roll with a raised ivory sugar-glaze spiral, soft buttery folds, and icing drips. Grounded at y=0 and designed for strong inventory readability.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Sweet Roll. Spiralled sweet bakery roll with visible icing streaks, rounded stepped shape. Actual recipe ingredients: dough, butter, sugar. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
